title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Commercial Goodwill Waivers
content:
## Nature of the waiver

When the billed party asks, the desk may reduce an invoice line of a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record by a commercial goodwill waiver, entered under the reason commercial goodwill. Whatever the applicable sizing rule yields is what the desk grants, in full; the desk has no discretion to grant less.

## Sizing wording, and where it still applies

The sizing wording set out here — a waiver capped at the product's goodwill percentage of whatever the invoice line still had open once earlier credits and waivers against it were taken off, held under the product's money cap, and rounded down to the cent — is **no longer in force** for a demurrage invoice line, where it has been superseded by the current basis for goodwill on demurrage. For a detention invoice line it continues to govern.

For this purpose, what is still open on a line means its invoiced figure minus the sum of the waivers and dispute credits that already point at it.

## Conditions, all read from the company's records

- **Yearly quota.** Counting every goodwill waiver the customer has received on any of its records in the 365 calendar days that end with the waiver date, that date included, the total has to be below the product's quota.
- **Request window.** The product's request window opens with the issue date of the invoice to be waived and runs for the stated number of calendar days. Its final day is that issue date advanced by those days; a request made on the final day still qualifies, and a later one does not.
- **One per line.** A second goodwill waiver on the same invoice line is not possible.
- **Pending disputes.** The amount goodwill is measured against is what remains of the invoice once any dispute lodged against it has been decided; an invoice whose dispute is still submitted has no such remainder yet.
- **Products without goodwill.** Where a product's goodwill percentage is 0, no goodwill is available under it.
- **Operational causes.** Waivers that rest on a delay the line caused, or on a terminal closure, lie outside the desk's authority; only the operations department grants them.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical: quota of 2, request window of 40 days)

| Situation | Judgement |
|---|---|
| one goodwill waiver in the trailing 365 days | quota available |
| two goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days | quota used up |
| an earlier goodwill waiver dated 365 days before the new waiver's date (the period covers the waiver date and the 364 days preceding it) | not counted |
| invoice dated 1 September, request on 11 October | inside the window, its last day |
| same invoice, request on 12 October | outside the window |
| a detention line of 400.00 with 100.00 already credited, percentage 10, cap 50.00 | 10 percent of 300.00 is 30.00, below the cap, so 30.00 |

superseded_clauses: The waiver is at most goodwill_waiver_pct_max percent of the amount still open on the invoice row after earlier credits and waivers, dnd_msr_invoice_credits, and never more than goodwill_waiver_cap_usd, rounded down to the cent
